name: Meshillemoth
overview: The name Meshillemoth appears in Scripture associated with faithful leadership and priestly lineage. In 2 Chronicles 28:12-13, Berechiah, identified as the son of Meshillemoth, stood among the Ephraimite heads who courageously opposed the Israelites’ attempt to enslave their fellow captives, urging restraint because of the great sin and divine wrath upon Israel. Additionally, Nehemiah 11:13 records a priestly descendant of Meshillemoth, highlighting his family's ongoing role in spiritual leadership. These references reveal Meshillemoth as a figure connected to godly protest and priestly heritage within Israel.
